title: TicketRecord
description: Front-matter schema for .product-brain/tickets/<TICKET_ID>.md. The structured fields here are mechanical (derived from git + PM data); prose sections in the body are LLM-generated and citation-validated.

title.description: Ticket title, fetched from the PM tool.

type.description: Ticket type from the PM tool. Defaults to 'unknown' if not classifiable.

status.description: Implementation status as inferred from git: any commits = in_progress; merged = shipped; reverted = abandoned.

shas.description: Commit SHAs that referenced this ticket, in chronological order.

prs.description: PR numbers associated with this ticket.

symbols.description: Function/class names extracted from diff hunk headers. Optional.

related_tickets.description: Other tickets that share >=2 files with this one. Computed at backfill, refreshed by repair.

reverted_by.description: SHAs of commits that revert work in this ticket. Populated by repair.

linked_bugs.description: Later bug tickets that reference this ticket. Populated by repair.

duration_days.description: Days between first_commit and last_commit. Used for estimation.

pr_open_to_merge_days.description: Days between PR open and merge, when available. Often a better proxy for effort.

manual_sections.description: Section names the LLM must NOT overwrite (e.g. 'Edge cases (manual)').
